tagline: Seasonal flower bouquets and bouquet subscriptions, grown no-till and spray-free in Bloomington.
about: Littlest Bird Farm is a flower-packed micro-farm in the middle of the city, started in 2023 by Julie Anna Teague — “with a dream and a lot of tulip bulbs.” No-till, regenerative practices protect the pollinators, and no pesticides are used. The goal: unique colors, heirloom varieties, herbs, ferns and perennials in every bouquet.
